caspian:email.description: Caspian email: ask reply-on-thread vs new email, then send
caspian:email.template:
Handle a Caspian email action.

If this session has inbound mail ([caspian:email]), ASK: reply on this thread OR send a separate new email?
- Thread → caspian_reply_email with body
- New email → caspian_send_email with to + real subject + body + confirmNewEmail=true

If no thread and user wants a new mail: caspian_send_email with to, real subject (never bare Re:), body.
Do not claim success without a tool result.

Arguments:
$ARGUMENTS

caspian:connect-email.description: Connect Caspian email (sandbox key or dashboard paste) and enable email
caspian:connect-email.template:
Use the caspian-connect-email skill.

1. Call caspian_setup_credentials mode=status
2. If not configured: ask sandbox (mode=sandbox) OR paste API key from https://dashboard.trycaspianai.com/login (mode=paste apiKey=…)
3. If RESTART REQUIRED after setup → quit/relaunch OpenCode, then rerun
4. Call caspian_connections
5. Call caspian_connect_email
6. If RESTART REQUIRED for channels → quit/relaunch so admit includes email

Arguments:
$ARGUMENTS

caspian:connect-telegram.description: Connect Caspian Telegram and enable telegram in caspian.json
caspian:connect-telegram.template:
Use the caspian-connect-telegram skill.

1. Call caspian_connections
2. Call caspian_connect_telegram
3. If missing token: instruct TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in .env or ~/.config/opencode/caspian.env (never caspian.json), then retry
4. If RESTART REQUIRED, tell the user to quit and relaunch OpenCode so admit includes telegram

caspian:telegram.description: Send a Telegram DM via Caspian (@username)
caspian:telegram.template:
Use the caspian-telegram skill (caspian:Telegram).

Parse to (@username or chat id) and body from the arguments.
Call caspian_send_telegram with to + body.
Always include this side note: Telegram bots cannot start a private chat — the recipient must message your bot first (Start / any message) before DMs work.
Do not claim success without a tool result.
